_comment: Regression floors for the default engine of each track. The floor test (test/test_benchmark_floor.py, opt-in via `pytest -m benchmark`) re-runs each engine at the recorded limit/seed and asserts its primary metric has not dropped below floor - epsilon. Floors are provisional, taken from the smoke subset; raise them deliberately after a full published run. Never lower a floor to make a red test pass — a real drop is a real regression.
